_comment: Framework runtime thresholds. Override values here to customize statusline + hooks without forking. Loaders fall back to hardcoded defaults if this file is missing or malformed.
_doc: See guides/context-management.md for the rationale behind each value.
_hrs_doc: HRS 7-signal weights (must sum to 1.0). Adjust to rebalance scoring for your project context.
_loop_doc: Phase 3 retry budgets per gate. Exceeding triggers escalation to user.
_retention_doc: Metrics event log retention. Auto-prune when either limit is hit.
_note_token_breakdown: Claude Code statusline API does not provide per-type token breakdown (input/cache_read/cache_create/output). Only used_percentage is available. Token breakdown and cost estimation features have been removed to avoid user confusion. If Claude Code adds breakdown data in the future, these features can be re-enabled.
